meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件压成精简格式,省下输入字数并留一份可读备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次对话都因记忆文件太长而挤占上下文空间。
copy.tagline_en: Shrink memory files to a compact format to cut input tokens, keeping a backup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if long memory files keep eating your context window.

howto.what: 把 CLAUDE.md、todo、偏好设置这类自然语言记忆文件压缩成穴居人式短句，以减少输入 token。压缩版会覆盖原文件，可读备份存到源码树之外的数据目录。
howto.when: 当输入 /caveman-compress <文件路径>，或你要求压缩某个记忆文件时触发。

say.note: 压缩后覆盖原文件，备份存到数据目录

say.text: 把我的 todo 文件压成穴居人语，省点 token
say.note: 只压正文，代码块和路径原样保留

howto.what_en: Turns memory files like CLAUDE.md, todos or preferences into caveman-speak to cut input tokens. The compressed text overwrites the original; a readable backup is saved to a data dir outside the source tree.
howto.when_en: Runs on /caveman-compress <filepath>, or when you ask to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: Overwrites the file; backup goes to data dir

say_en.text: Compress my todo.md into caveman speak to save tokens
say_en.note: Code blocks and paths stay untouched
